title: Immunofluorescence Protocol for GPNMB and TFE3 Detection in ASPS Cells
author: Franz Zemp
materials: Permeabilize the fixed cells using 0.5% Triton X-100.
Incubate cells overnight at 4°C with both primary antibodies simultaneously:
Rabbit monoclonal anti-TFE3 (Sigma Cell Marque, 354R-15) at 1:25 dilution
Incubate with secondary antibodies at 1 µg/mL for 30 minutes at room temperature:
DyLight™ 488 Donkey anti-rabbit IgG for TFE3 detection

steps.title: Culture ASPS cells
steps.instruction: Seed ASPS cells on chamber slides or coverslips and culture in Opti-MEM™ supplemented with 10 % FBS for 48 hours.

steps.title: Add primary GPNMB antibody
steps.instruction: Incubate cells with goat polyclonal anti‑human GPNMB (R&D Systems, catalog AF2550) at a final concentration of 20 µg mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Add secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Incubate with Alexa Fluor® 647 donkey anti‑goat IgG for GPNMB detection.

steps.title: Mount with antifade
steps.instruction: Place one drop of ProLong™ Gold antifade reagent containing DAPI onto each slide and cover with a coverslip.

steps.title: Acquire fluorescence images
steps.instruction: Image the stained slides on an ECHO Revolve fluorescent microscope (ECHO, RVL‑100‑M) at 40× resolution.
